statement: Only the payee resolves (with the secret, in time) or cancels a lock; anyone expires it after the deadline plus reserve. The Quint cell holds the two refusals: the payer cannot cancel its own lock and cannot resolve it (cancel-by-anyone, resolve-by-payer); the expiry by anyone after the deadline plus the reserve is held there under R-HTLC-CLOCK, not under this id.
